jtb2026: keyword and semantic search over tabular data

Source: R/jtb2026-package.R
jtb2026-package.Rd

The package answers one question: which rows of this table mention the thing I am looking for? It accepts an Excel workbook, a delimited file or an in-memory data frame, searches the columns you name, and hands back the matching rows – optionally writing them to a CSV file on the way out.

Main functions

jtb_search_keyword()

Literal or regular-expression matching. Returns every row that contains the term, in the original row order.

jtb_search_semantic()

Similarity ranking. Returns rows scored by TF-IDF cosine similarity with synonym expansion and fuzzy character n-gram matching, or by your own embedding function.

jtb_read_table()

The shared reader, exported so you can inspect what the search functions saw.

Mock data

site_reports is a 24-row table of fictional study-site comments, used throughout the documentation site in doc/.
